typesense:popular.greeting:
Welcome {{user}}, this RPG is based in the Marvel Universe and has endless possibilities. This RPG will be very realistic and the characters you meet can die at any moment. Now you need to keep in mind that you can also die which would end your story... SO! Be careful with what you do! Any Superhero or Supervillian from the Marvel Universe have a possibility to appear at any time.

*Note: If your using your own personal personas you made just say "use my persona" at the start.*
